abstract: There have been claims of an increased risk for gestational trophoblastic disease (i.e., hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma) in Vietnam since the period of Agent Orange sprayings. In 1990, we conducted a case-control study in Ho Chi Minh City to investigate risk factors for gestational trophoblastic disease in Vietnam. Eighty-seven married women, all of whom had a recent pathologic diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic disease, identified in the Obstetrical and Gynecological Hospital, were included in the study. Eighty-seven married women who were admitted mainly in the surgery departments of the same hospital were the controls, and they were matched to cases for age and area of residence. Odds ratios (ORs), adjusted for matching variables and other potential confounders, were estimated with unconditional logistic regression. A statistically significant trend in risk was observed with previous live births (p = .01). Cases were found to eat less meat per wk (OR = 0.4, 95% confidence interval [95% CI] = 0.2-0.9 for > or = five meat dishes) and to own fewer consumer goods than controls. An increase in risk was associated with the breeding of pigs (OR = 5.7, 95% CI = 1.2-27.6 for raising three or more pigs). A cumulative Agent Orange exposure index was constructed, using the patient's complete residence history. No significant difference was found between cases and controls for this index (OR = 0.7, 95% CI = 0.2-1.8 for high-exposure category), nor was such a difference noted for the agricultural use of pesticides.
abstract_ja: ベトナムでは、枯葉剤が散布された時期以降に妊娠性絨毛性疾患(すなわち胞状奇胎および絨毛癌)のリスクが増加したとの主張がある。1990年、我々はホーチミン市で妊娠性絨毛性疾患のリスク因子を調べる症例対照研究を実施した。産婦人科病院で最近病理学的に妊娠性絨毛性疾患と診断された既婚女性87名を対象とした。対照は、同じ病院の主に外科病棟に入院していた既婚女性87名であり、年齢と居住地域で症例と適合させた。交絡因子など他の潜在的な要因で調整したオッズ比(OR)を、非条件付きロジスティック回帰により推定した。既往の生児出産数との間で、有意なリスクの傾向が認められた(p = .01)。症例は対照に比べ、週あたりの肉料理の摂取量が少なく(5皿以上でOR = 0.4、95%信頼区間[95% CI] = 0.2-0.9)、所有する消費財も少なかった。豚の飼育(豚を3頭以上飼育でOR = 5.7、95% CI = 1.2-27.6)はリスク増加と関連していた。患者の居住歴全体を用いて、累積枯葉剤曝露指標を作成した。この指標については、症例と対照で有意差は認められなかった(高曝露群でOR = 0.7、95% CI = 0.2-1.8)。農業用農薬の使用についても同様であった。
